title: The Birth of Karona
summary: Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka merge into a being worshipped as a false god.
narrative: Jeska’s transformation into Phage and the creation of Akroma drew Otaria into an escalating conflict of vengeance and devotion.
A catastrophic confrontation joined Phage, Akroma, and Zagorka into Karona, whose immense power placed the continent in even greater danger.
